items.title: Uber’s Drones Officially Have a Rival: DoorDash CEO Says Its Dots Robots Handle “Close to 10%” of Phoenix Volume
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash CEO Tony Xu says its Dot robots now complete close to 10% of orders in Phoenix, the same week Uber started delivering Uber Eats orders by drone in Texas. DoorDash builds its own robots and drones while Uber relies on partners, which could give DoorDash the better shot at a lower cost per order.

items.title: What Does DoorDash (DASH) Denial Of Surveillance Pricing Mean For Investors?
items.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) publicly rejected allegations of surveillance pricing after an FTC pricing inquiry was disclosed on 20 November 2026. The company said its algorithms do not adjust individual fees using personal data beyond location, order details and local market conditions. DoorDash confirmed cooperation with the wider FTC review of delivery and rideshare pricing practices covering multiple on demand platforms.
